cc:Work.dc:description: Making the agreed profile a Nash equilibrium is weaker than making each agreed action dominant against every opponent action. The Chicken agreement is asymmetric (de-escalate, escalate); the protocol agreement selects public disclosure. A zero Nash boundary means the agreement is already an equilibrium before penalties. Strict dominance requires exceeding the boundary.
